meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.47
§ Giddel = "very great"
1) the head of a family of temple slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel
2) the head of the descendants of Solomon's servants returning from exile with Zerubbabel

elsewhere.note: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
